direct_evidence: British Virgin Islands endemic Vachellia anegadensis was studied on Anegada and Fallen Jerusalem with direct flower-visitor observations and pollinator-dependency experiments; animal visitation, especially Lepidoptera, increased seed-pod production
reason: Replaces a regional alien-flora trait compilation with direct endemic-plant pollination and reproductive evidence; no matched historical community transition

direct_evidence: Natural Vanilla mexicana populations were sampled across Guadeloupe; insect-exclusion bagging and natural fruit-set measurements showed approximately equal fruit set (~54%), with population genetics supporting predominant selfing/autogamy
reason: Direct local reproductive experiment resolves Guadeloupe source quality; evidence supports autogamy rather than a community-transition mechanism

reason: Provides direct source-native evidence for persistence of a specialized pollination mutualism in the Marquesas; no matched source-state transition or plant response

direct_evidence: Five days of in-situ flowering-season observations on Pitcairn recorded ants early in flower life and more frequent bee visits, especially afternoons; the species history and ex-situ material are independently documented in Curtis's Botanical Magazine
reason: Direct local visitor observation clears the search-quality gap, but the short observational window and lack of natural reproductive-effect experiment are insufficient for global-confrontation promotion
